Act 0: Before China

The story

Alex pitches an idea about people, and her boss stops her after four sentences. Tory, the man the boss listens to, tells her the idea was good. They fall in love. She chooses to dye her hair pink and quit her job, and their startup runs on her credit cards.

Then her car breaks down and Tory disappears. Job rejections and delivery work end in eviction, and she lives in her car. Her friend Nia and her grandmother, Ah Ma, keep reaching for her. She finally accepts help, and the ticket to Guangzhou.

The turn: accepting help is a choice, not a defeat.

Three weeks of testing

  • One script a day. It goes out as short videos in two of our four styles, plus one in full motion.
  • The styles rotate, so every pair of styles runs together once every six days.
  • We read who stays past 3 seconds, how long they watch, and the shares, saves, follows and comments.
♪ Mon 30 Nov: MV01, Never Our Plan. The San Francisco year as a song. See it on the calendar   ★ Mon 7 Dec: the styles are chosen. See it on the calendar

The characters

Alex Mei

24, half Chinese and half white, 5 ft 3. She wants to tell stories about people. Her look changes with the story: long black hair, then pink, then the pink cut out. The Cherry Peptide Lip Tint hangs on her phone as a charm in every phone shot.

Nia

Alex's best friend at work, 31. She warns her about the credit cards, and later finds her.

Tory

The man the boss listens to. Kind at first, then gone. His face is not shown until MV04.

The boss

San Francisco. He stops Alex's pitch after four sentences and asks for numbers.

Ah Ma

Alex's grandmother in Guangzhou. She speaks no English. She sends the Out of Colours makeup, and the plane ticket.
